title: Single Nucleus Profiling Reveals Rewired Tumor-Immune-Stromal Cell Communication in Plasmacytoid Urothelial Carcinoma.

snippet: Plasmacytoid urothelial carcinoma (PUC) is an aggressive histologic subtype of bladder cancer associated with worse patient outcomes and therapeutic response compared to conventional urothelial carcinoma (CUC).
